title: Ruling Elder Robert H. Zeigler v. Presbytery of Texas
disposition_detail: The Assembly adopted the Judicial Commission's report and confirmed the judgment of the lower court (10-0); no issue-level merits or adopted reasons are stated.
first_summary: A ruling elder complained that the Presbytery of Texas appointed a committee rather than a commission and had it meet with the pastor and Session before the complainants. The General Assembly's Judicial Commission confirmed the lower court judgment 10-0, without giving reasons.
summary: A ruling elder complained that the Presbytery of Texas, handling a complaint against a session, appointed a committee rather than the requested commission and had that committee meet with the pastor, session members, and congregants before meeting the complainants. The Assembly adopted the Judicial Commission's report and unanimously confirmed the lower court's judgment (10-0). No adopted reasons or issue-level merits appear, so the case's value is a sparse example of a confirmed judgment without explanation.
